SELECT
  startsat AS time,
  id as firing
FROM alert
WHERE
  startsat BETWEEN (TO_TIMESTAMP(${__from:date:seconds}) - INTERVAL '5 minutes') AND (TO_TIMESTAMP(${__to:date:seconds}) - INTERVAL '5 minutes')
  AND status='firing'
ORDER BY startsat

SELECT
  startsat AS time,
  status,
  id AS "id"
FROM alert
WHERE
  startsat BETWEEN (TO_TIMESTAMP(${__from:date:seconds}) - INTERVAL '5 minutes') AND (TO_TIMESTAMP(${__to:date:seconds}) - INTERVAL '5 minutes')

SELECT
	al.alertid AS "id",
	lkv.value AS "severity"
FROM
	alertlabel al
	INNER JOIN labelkv lkv ON al.labelkvid = lkv.id
WHERE
	al.alertid IN (
	SELECT
		id 
	FROM
		alert 
	WHERE
	  startsat BETWEEN (TO_TIMESTAMP(${__from:date:seconds}) - INTERVAL '5 minutes') AND (TO_TIMESTAMP(${__to:date:seconds}) - INTERVAL '5 minutes')
	  AND status='firing'
	)
	AND lkv.labelkey='severity'
